forks.question: When a person explicitly requests resumption of a follow-up closed before both repairs in its current allowance were used, how many repairs should remain available?

options.says: The factory resumes the same follow-up with only the unused repairs from its existing allowance, checking each repair with fresh CI.
The factory resumes the same follow-up with a fresh allowance of up to two repairs, checking each repair with fresh CI.

usage.summary: [F5 in proposal.json](/var/folders/fz/s3p17rl97r30y73d180fjbmc0000gn/T/invariant-formalize-4227924644/proposal.json) asks whether resuming a follow-up closed early preserves unused repairs (A) or grants two fresh repairs (B). Per your instructions, statements are empty and the module is withheld until that choice is answered.
